name: Student Emergency Grant
description: One-time help for an unexpected expense or a short-term gap. Rolling; decided in about 3 business days.

name: Textbook & Supplies Scholarship
description: Books and supplies for Pell-eligible full-time students. Paid about 2 weeks after the deadline.

name: Dean's Merit Scholarship
description: Merit award for sophomores and juniors with a 3.5 GPA or higher. Credited to the spring bill.

name: Spring Opportunity Scholarship
description: Need-based award for the spring semester. Paid in January.

name: Federal Work-Study: Library Assistant
description: Up to 10 hours a week at the main library. Starts the Monday after you're hired; paid on the campus pay schedule.

name: Engineering Senior Design Grant
description: Materials for senior design projects in Engineering.
